title: Accounts Receivable
description:
CMA is supporting an established business in Portsmouth with the appointment of a part-time Accounts Receivable professional. Working 25 hours per week, this role offers flexibility around working days and hours, along with the opportunity to contribute to the smooth financial and front-of-house operation of the business.

What will the Accounts Receivable role involve?
- Supporting the effective management of incoming customer payments and receivables activity
- Helping maintain accurate financial records and ensuring transactions are processed promptly
- Assisting with queries and providing a professional point of contact when required
- Providing reception cover during lunch periods, supporting the day-to-day running of the office
- Working flexibly across an agreed 25-hour schedule

Suitable Candidate for the Accounts Receivable vacancy:
- Previous experience in accounts receivable, credit control or a similar finance position
- Confident handling financial information with a careful and organised approach
- Professional communication skills, with the ability to support both finance and reception activities
- Reliable, adaptable and comfortable working independently within a part-time arrangement

Additional benefits and information for the role of Accounts Receivable:
- Part-time working pattern of 25 hours per week
- Free parking
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays (pro rata)
- Salary will be dependent on experience

title: Accounts Receivable Clerk
description:
A part-time Finance role offering genuine flexibility without compromising on career satisfaction. This permanent Accounts Receivable Clerk position offers 25 hours per week at £15-£16 per hour, with flexibility around how those hours are spread across the week. Based in Portsmouth, the role also benefits from free on-site parking.

You'll be joining a friendly, close-knit finance team within an established organisation, where your contribution will be valued and you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of a varied role.

Reporting to the Finance Supervisor, you will be responsible for:
- Monitoring the customer ledger and keeping accounts accurate and up to date
- Carrying out credit control by phone and email when required
- Collecting and posting credit card receipts onto the finance system
- Completing daily banking, including uploading and reconciling the GBP bank account
- Providing occasional cover across accounts payable
- Covering reception during breaks, including answering calls and welcoming visitors

What you will need:
- At least 2 years' experience in a similar finance role, such as Accounts Receivable Clerk, Sales Ledger Clerk, Credit Controller or Finance Assistant
- AAT Level 2 would be advantageous, although relevant experience will also be considered
- VLOOKUP and PivotTable skills would be helpful but aren't a must

What you will get:
- 25 hours per week, ideally across 5 days, with flexibility around the working pattern
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, pro rata, with an additional day for every 5 years' service
- 4% pension contribution
- Free onsite parking, subject to availability
- Cycle to work scheme
- A friendly, close-knit finance team where recognition and support are part of the culture

If you would like to find out more about this role, please apply with your CV or LinkedIn PDF. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Credit Control
description:
Join a reputable financial services company based in Portsmouth, committed to delivering exceptional customer services within a vibrant, inclusive, and forward-thinking culture.

As part of a growing organisation recognised for its integrity and dedication to employee development, you will play a vital role in managing customer credit accounts, ensuring smooth cash flow and fostering positive relationships. The role is initially offered for a period of 3 months with the possibility of extension.

What the Credit Control role involves:
- Ensure timely receivables and maintain healthy cash flow
- Engaging with customers through various channels to facilitate prompt payments and understanding their needs
- Collaborating with sales and finance teams to optimise collection processes and outcomes
- Supporting vulnerable customers by applying empathetic and compliant approaches
- Addressing billing disputes efficiently, aiming for fair resolutions
- Ensuring all activities align with FCA regulations, prioritising ethical and compliant credit management

Suitable Candidate for the Credit Control vacancy:
- Demonstrates excellent communication skills, with a professional approach to customer engagement
- Has experience in credit control, accounts receivable, or customer service
- Shows strong organisational skills, with meticulous attention to detail
- Possesses a proactive and results-driven attitude focused on achieving targets

Additional benefits and information for the role of Credit Control:
- Flexible working arrangements to support work-life balance following training
- Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing training
- Supportive team environment fostering collaboration and innovation
- Free parking
- Salary will be dependent on experience

title: CUSTOMER SERVICE ADVISOR
company: Talent Sure Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Location: Portsmouth, Hampshire

Position: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday Friday (Shifts between 8:00am 6:15pm), plus 1 in 5 Saturdays (with a day off in lieu during the week)

Salary: £27,000 £28,000 per annum

About the Opportunity

We are recruiting on behalf of a leading specialist financial services provider based in Portsmouth. Widely recognised for their supportive workplace culture, structured career development, and excellent employee perks, they are seeking empathetic Customer Service Advisors to join their customer support team.

In this role, you will act as a reassuring point of contact for customers navigating complex or sensitive policy enquiries. Balancing empathy with attention to detail, you will guide customers through internal processes, evaluate policy terms, and deliver fair, prompt resolutions.

Full onboarding and comprehensive training are provided from day one, making this an ideal platform to build a long-term career within financial services and customer operations.

Key Responsibilities
- Customer Support & Guidance: Serve as a compassionate first point of contact, guiding policyholders step-by-step through their case enquiries.
- Policy Evaluation & Resolution: Review customer documentation against policy terms and conditions, making prompt, fair assessment decisions and explaining outcomes clearly.
- Information Verification: Ensure accurate data cross-referencing and coordinate with external partners or underwriting teams where appropriate.
- Query & Dispute Management: Handle customer questions and case disputes constructively, aiming for positive, professional outcomes.
- Administration & Compliance: Maintain accurate digital records, prioritise daily caseloads, and ensure full adherence to regulatory standards.

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking positive, empathetic individuals who bring strong communication skills and a genuine desire to assist others during challenging circumstances.

Key Attributes & Experience:
- Customer-Facing Experience: Background in customer service, contact centre environments, telephony support, or retail administration is desirable.
- Empathy & Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with the ability to listen actively and handle sensitive conversations calmly.
- Problem-Solving Ability: A practical, proactive approach to evaluating information and resolving customer enquiries efficiently.
- Organisation & IT Literacy: Confident using computer systems and managing daily task workloads accurately.

What the Business Offers

Our client provides an exceptional reward and benefits package designed to support health, wellbeing, and financial security:
- Health & Wellbeing Perks: Free Health Cash Plan, mental health support, and wellness initiatives.
- Generous Insurance Discounts: Exclusive discounts on personal motor and home insurance policies.
- Retail & Lifestyle Rewards: Access to a high-street rewards scheme offering discounts across major retailers and leisure brands.
- Career Growth: Clear progression pathways, ongoing coaching, and continuous learning opportunities.
- Great Workplace Culture: Join a friendly, supportive team in modern Portsmouth offices with regular social events and team incentives.

How to Apply

If you are an empathetic communicator looking to develop your career with a supportive, growth-oriented employer, please submit your CV today for immediate consideration.

title: Finance Assistant
description:

title: Operation Coordinator
description:
Operations Coordinator Salary: up to 30,000

Based in Portsmouth

Hybrid role: 3 days in office, 2 days at home

Are you looking to work for a company that offers development and growth in your role?

A global business consultancy is looking for an Operations Coordinator to join team based in Portsmouth. This role will involve predominantly providing logistical and administrative support to on their programs to ensure clients projects are run smoothly. This is a great opportunity to develop a career into project management.

Duties Include:
- Schedule workshops and Virtual Group Coaching sessions
- Coordinate Facilitators and Coaches and maintain relationships with external facilitators

- Provide support via telephone, system, and email helpdesks
- Work in close partnership with client and internal account teams to put forward recommendations for process improvement
- Maintaining accurate data on the businesses ERP system.

Experience Required
- Administrative experience highly desirable with the ability to juggle workload
- Organized, analytical, and experience of working on multiple projects simultaneously, with exceptional attention to detail
- Graduate educated desirable
- Strong communication, both verbally and in writing
- Logical thinker with the ability to prioritize workload and delegation
- Experience using virtual meeting platforms (such as Zoom or Microsoft Teams.)
- Experience in using Microsoft Office Suite is required (Outlook, Excel, Word & PowerPoint.)

Benefits
- 25 days holiday plus Bank Holidays + close at Xmas
- Private Medical Insurance

- Task Human App (discount on personal training, cooking session, counselling etc

title: Payroll officer / Clerk - Power/civil engineering
description:
We are looking for a reliable, organised and enthusiastic Payroll Officer to join a civil enigneering and Utilities contractor based in Portsmouth.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with payroll experience, strong attention to detail and a good understanding of payroll administration. The successful candidate will be responsible for paying employees and supply chain accurately and on time, and keeps the company compliant with HMRC on PAYE, CIS and VAT. The postholder prepares and processes; approval and release sit with the Financial Controller and authorised signatories.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing weekly and/or monthly payroll.
- Maintaining accurate employee records and payroll information.
- Processing new starters, leavers and changes to employee details.
- Checking timesheets, working hours, overtime and absences.
- Calculating wages, deductions, PAYE and National Insurance contributions.
- Administering pension contributions and statutory payments.
- Responding to payroll queries from employees in a professional and timely manner.
- Ensuring payroll deadlines are met and all information is processed accurately.
- Maintaining confidentiality of employee and payroll information.
- Providing general administrative support where required.

The Ideal Candidate
- Previous payroll experience is essential/preferred.
- Good understanding of payroll processes, PAYE and National Insurance.
- Experience using payroll software and Microsoft Excel.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Ability to work to deadlines and manage competing priorities.
- A professional, approachable and helpful manner.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
- A friendly and supportive working environment.
- Opportunities for training and development.
- The opportunity to become part of an established team.

Amour Recruitment are pleased to be recruiting for an experienced Customer Service Receptionist on behalf of our client based in Portsmouth.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a well-established, family-run business specialising in the repair and maintenance of commercial vehicles and trailers. Working as part of a busy depot team, you'll be the first point of contact for customers, supporting workshop operations, coordinating service bookings and ensuring a first-class customer experience throughout every stage of the repair and servicing process.

This is a varied and fast-paced role that would suit someone who thrives in a customer-facing environment, enjoys multitasking and takes pride in keeping things organised and running smoothly. Full training will be provided on company systems and processes.

Responsibilities:
- Meeting and greeting customers in person, by telephone and email.
- Managing service bookings, scheduled servicing, MOT and tachograph appointments.
- Coordinating vehicle breakdowns and keeping customers updated throughout the process.
- Maintaining electronic job cards and workshop management systems.
- Liaising closely with workshop teams to monitor progress and communicate updates.
- Obtaining customer authorisations, preparing estimates and ensuring completed work is ready for invoicing.
- Processing completed jobs and forwarding documentation for payment.
- Receiving and allocating parts and consumables to relevant jobs.
- Monitoring courtesy vehicles and company vehicle usage.
- Providing administrative support to the workshop, service and parts departments.
- Supporting customer retention through excellent service and communication.

Requirements:
- Minimum 2 years' experience within the automotive industry.
- Previous experience within a service, reception or dealership environment.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills.
- Professional and confident telephone manner.
- Good IT skills and ability to learn new systems quickly.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to prioritise workload and remain calm in a busy environment.
- Proactive and positive approach to work.
- A genuine desire to build a long-term career within the automotive sector.

Hours:

Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 6:00pm (30-minute unpaid lunch break)

Every third Saturday, 8:00am - 12:00pm

Flexible start and finish times may be considered.

Salary: £28,000 to £32,000 DOE

Benefits:
- 28 days annual leave including bank holidays.
- Enhanced annual leave with length of service.
- NEST Pension Scheme.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.
- Additional benefits available after 12 months' service, subject to eligibility.

If you're an experienced customer service professional with automotive industry experience and are looking to join a growing business that genuinely values its employees, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply today and the Amour Recruitment team will be in touch.
